hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: Custom curve AMM hook (EulerSwap v2) for Uniswap v4 that fully handles swaps in beforeSwap using BeforeSwapDelta, routing input tokens into and output tokens out of Euler lending vaults. Supports exact-input and exact-output swaps with an optional expiration deadline; blocks v3-style CLAMM liquidity additions and donations.
